claim: PF-ERI treats the candidate image pair as the primary scientific object and evaluates evidence admission rather than automatic identity assignment.
permitted_wording: PF-ERI treats the candidate image pair as the primary scientific object and evaluates evidence admission rather than automatic identity assignment.
prohibited_extension: Not an identity-accuracy, retrieval-ranking, or descriptor-replacement claim.

claim: Descriptor-relation support and human visual reviewability are distinct pair-level gates.
permitted_wording: Descriptor-relation support and human visual reviewability are distinct pair-level gates.
prohibited_extension: The 637 descriptor-unsupported pairs must not be relabelled as 637 human-rejected pairs.

claim: P5 passed the Task15I component-disjoint development screen with a P3-minus-P5 Brier increment of 0.0058629 and nonnegative increments in all five folds.
permitted_wording: P5 passed the Task15I component-disjoint development screen with a P3-minus-P5 Brier increment of 0.0058629 and nonnegative increments in all five folds.
prohibited_extension: Development qualification only; not external confirmation.

claim: P3 and P5 were frozen with lambda 100, fixed preprocessing, and a five-column pair-evidence increment.
permitted_wording: P3 and P5 were frozen with lambda 100, fixed preprocessing, and a five-column pair-evidence increment.
prohibited_extension: No refitting or post-confirmation model reselection.

claim: Task15L completed apparent probability calibration for frozen P3 and P5 on 448 pairs.
permitted_wording: Task15L completed apparent probability calibration for frozen P3 and P5 on 448 pairs.
prohibited_extension: Calibration completion is not independent predictive validation.

claim: The external execution covered 889 candidate pairs, with 252 descriptor-supported and 637 descriptor-unsupported pairs, and produced 504 calibrated predictions without recorded supported-path execution failure.
permitted_wording: The external execution covered 889 candidate pairs, with 252 descriptor-supported and 637 descriptor-unsupported pairs, and produced 504 calibrated predictions without recorded supported-path execution failure.
prohibited_extension: Execution validation and pair-support coverage only.

claim: The retained decisions are accepted as human-authored outcomes with timestamps excluded and major protocol deviations disclosed.
permitted_wording: The retained decisions are accepted as human-authored outcomes with timestamps excluded and major protocol deviations disclosed.
prohibited_extension: Cannot be represented as a fully clean preregistered confirmation.

claim: The Task15I P5 increment did not reproduce in the frozen independent outcome comparison on 252 supported Task15M pairs.
permitted_wording: The Task15I P5 increment did not reproduce in the frozen independent outcome comparison on 252 supported Task15M pairs.
prohibited_extension: P5 external superiority over P3 is not established.

claim: Endpoint prevalence and pair support differed materially across development, calibration, and confirmation stages.
permitted_wording: Endpoint prevalence and pair support differed materially across development, calibration, and confirmation stages.
prohibited_extension: Descriptive transport evidence; not a proven causal explanation for model performance.

claim: The project was operationally closed as CONFIRMED on the bounded Task15M execution-validation scope.
permitted_wording: The project was operationally closed as CONFIRMED on the bounded Task15M execution-validation scope.
prohibited_extension: Operational closure does not establish P5 superiority, identity accuracy, or deployment utility.

claim: PF-ERI v2 does not establish automatic identity assignment, mAP, MRR, top-k improvement, or deployment readiness.
permitted_wording: PF-ERI v2 does not establish automatic identity assignment, mAP, MRR, top-k improvement, or deployment readiness.
prohibited_extension: These outcomes were not established by the v2 evidence contract.
